name: waveshare-esp32s3-epaper
description: Espruino TypeScript application for Waveshare ESP32-S3 e-Paper 1.54"

scripts.firmware:flash: uvx esptool --chip esp32s3 --port /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 write_flash --flash_mode dio --flash_size detect --flash_freq 80m 0x0 firmware/bootloader.bin 0x8000 firmware/partition-table.bin 0x10000 firmware/espruino-esp32s3.bin
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run upload
